```{r Simulations, include=FALSE}


## Create the function to simulate data

# simulate the null hypothesis that bees are treating each cavity equally, thus nesting would be based just on availability
# simulation without replacement so that if there are multiple new osmia nests, the number of available cavities goes down by one for each sequential new nest in that subsite-group combo

# create a function to simulate the distribution of nests based on the null hypothesis that bees are nesting according to available cavities 
simulate_nests <- function(avail_cavities, total_nests) {
  n <- length(avail_cavities) # number of available cavities
  nest_counts <- rep(0, n) # start with zero nests in each trapnest

  # keep as zeros is no nests are built
  if (total_nests == 0) {
    return(nest_counts)
  }

  # look through each of the new nests to be randomly assigned
  for (i in 1:total_nests) {
    if (sum(avail_cavities) == 0) break  # stop if all cavities used
    probability <- avail_cavities / sum(avail_cavities) # calculate probability proportional to the number of available cavities
    chosen <- sample(1:n, size = 1, prob = probability) # randomly choose a trapnest for the new nest based on available cavities
    nest_counts[chosen] <- nest_counts[chosen] + 1 # record it
    avail_cavities[chosen] <- avail_cavities[chosen] - 1 # reduce the number of available cavities by 1, when we apply the function the loop will run again until no new nests are left
  }
  return(nest_counts) # return the vector with how many nests were randomly assigned
}

# indicate how many simulated data columns we want for the model
n_sim <- 100 


## Apply the function

trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_os)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


## Apply the function

trapnesting_meg_null <- trapnesting_meg %>%
  group_by(Subsite, Date) %>%
  group_modify(~ { # simulate random nest distribution for subsite-date combo
    for (i in 1:n_sim){ # make each of the columns we indicated that we want 
    nest_counts <- simulate_nests(.x$Available_cavities_prior, sum(.x$New_nests_meg)) # use available cavities as weights and sum the new nests
    .x[[paste0('Null_new_nests', i)]] <- nest_counts # make the new column
    }
    .x # return the modified group
  }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


```

```{r Ordering_treatments, include=FALSE}


## Ordering treatments
trapnesting_os_null$Treatment <- factor(trapnesting_os_null$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
trapnesting_meg_null$Treatment <- factor(trapnesting_meg_null$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))

nesting_cells_os$Treatment <- factor(nesting_cells_os$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
nesting_cells_meg$Treatment <- factor(nesting_cells_meg$Treatment, 
                                    levels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))

## Make mean of null new nests
trapnesting_os_null <- trapnesting_os_null %>% mutate(Null_new_nests_mean = rowMeans(select(., Null_new_nests1:Null_new_nests100)))
trapnesting_meg_null <- trapnesting_meg_null %>% mutate(Null_new_nests_mean = rowMeans(select(., Null_new_nests1:Null_new_nests100)))
```

## Congeneric Attraction

```{r P1_Congeneric_Attraction, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


## Osmia ##

# make proportion of new nests / available cavities
P1_os <- trapnesting_os_null %>% 
  select(Trapnest, Treatment, Date, New_nests_os, Available_cavities_prior, Null_new_nests_mean) %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(sum_New_nests_os = sum(New_nests_os), sum_Available_cavities_prior = sum(Available_cavities_prior), sum_Null_new_nests_mean = sum(Null_new_nests_mean)) 

P1_os <- P1_os %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(Prop_new_of_avail_obs = (sum_New_nests_os/sum_Available_cavities_prior), Prop_new_of_avail_null = (sum_Null_new_nests_mean/sum_Available_cavities_prior))

# pivot longer
P1_os <- P1_os %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c('Prop_new_of_avail_obs', 'Prop_new_of_avail_null'),
    names_to = 'Data_type',
    values_to = 'Proportion'
  )

# make the mean and error bars
P1_os_sum <- P1_os %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Data_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Proportion),
    SD = sd(Proportion), 
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    CI_low = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


Fig_p1_os <- P1_os_sum %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Mean, x = Treatment, fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                width = 0.3,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Prop_new_of_avail_null" = "#F0C282",
      "Prop_new_of_avail_obs"  = "#50898E"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia) ~ "Data"),
    breaks = c("Prop_new_of_avail_null", "Prop_new_of_avail_obs"),
    labels = c("Simulated", "Observed")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)



## Megachile ##

# make proportion of new nests / available cavities
P1_meg <- trapnesting_meg_null %>% 
  select(Trapnest, Treatment, Date, New_nests_meg, Available_cavities_prior, Null_new_nests_mean) %>%

  summarise(sum_New_nests_meg = sum(New_nests_meg), sum_Available_cavities_prior = sum(Available_cavities_prior), sum_Null_new_nests_mean = sum(Null_new_nests_mean)) 

P1_meg <- P1_meg %>% 
  group_by(Trapnest, Treatment) %>% 
  summarise(Prop_new_of_avail_obs = (sum_New_nests_meg/sum_Available_cavities_prior), Prop_new_of_avail_null = (sum_Null_new_nests_mean/sum_Available_cavities_prior))

# pivot longer
P1_meg <- P1_meg %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c('Prop_new_of_avail_obs', 'Prop_new_of_avail_null'),
    names_to = 'Data_type',
    values_to = 'Proportion'
  )

# make the mean and error bars
P1_meg_sum <- P1_meg %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Data_type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Proportion),
    SD = sd(Proportion),
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    CI_low = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Fig_p1_meg <- P1_meg_sum %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = Mean, x = Treatment, fill = Data_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                width = 0.3,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Prop_new_of_avail_null" = "#F0C282",
      "Prop_new_of_avail_obs"  = "#B6686B"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile) ~ "Data"),
    breaks = c("Prop_new_of_avail_null", "Prop_new_of_avail_obs"),
    labels = c("Simulated", "Observed")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)


## Combine figures 


combined_p1 <-  Fig_p1_os | Fig_p1_meg + theme(legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.position = "right")

# make lengends stack ontop of each other
combined_p1 <- combined_p1 + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.box = "vertical") 

Fig_p1 <- combined_p1 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = NULL) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

P1_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Proportion of new nests built in available cavities",
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

P1_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Occupant density treatment",
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# combine them into a single plot object
Fig_p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(P1_left_label, Fig_p1, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95))
Fig_p1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p1, P1_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

# save
ggsave("Figures/Fig_p1.png", Fig_p1, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)

sum(trapnesting_os_null$New_nests_os) # 161
sum(trapnesting_meg_null$New_nests_meg) # 137
```

## Parasite Attraction

```{r P2_Parasite_Attraction, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


## Osmia ##

# number of parasitized nests
P2_os <- nesting_cells_os %>% 
  select(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_ID, Nest_parasitized) %>% 
  arrange(Nest_parasitized, Nest_ID) %>% 
  group_by(Nest_ID) %>% 
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# count totals
P2_os_sum <- P2_os %>%
  count(Treatment, Trapnest, Nest_parasitized)

# create mean and error bars
P2_os_sum <- P2_os_sum %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Nest_parasitized) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(n),
    SD = sd(n),
    SE = SD / sqrt(n()),
    CI_low = Mean - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_high = Mean + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot
Fig_p2_os <- P2_os_sum %>% 
  filter(Nest_parasitized == 'parasitized') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = Mean, x = Treatment)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", fill = '#50898E') +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    limits = c(0, 4),
    labels = 0:4
  ) 
  

## Megachile ##

# sample size
table(P2_os$Nest_parasitized) # 27 no, 54 yes
```

## Parasite Avoidance

```{r P3a_Parasite_Avoidance, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


## Osmia ##

P3a_os <- trapnesting_os_null %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = New_nests_os, x = DP_os_prior)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.09, width = 0.09, alpha = 0.4, color = "#50898E", shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm', color = "#50898E", fill = "#50898E") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:5,
    limits = c(0, 5.5),
    labels = 0:5
  )  +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)
  

## Megachile ##

P3a_meg <- trapnesting_meg_null %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = New_nests_meg, x = DP_meg_prior)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.09, width = 0.09, alpha = 0.4, color = "#B6686B", shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm',  color = "#B6686B", fill = "#B6686B") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = 0:2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:5,
    limits = c(0, 5.5),
    labels = 0:5
  )  +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)


# Combine 
        
combined_p3a <- P3a_os + P3a_meg + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 3), guides = "collect")
```

```{r P3b_Investment, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Osmia ##

# make proportion data for figure
nesting_investment_os <- nesting_investment_os %>% mutate(Prop_filled = Filled_length / Straw_length)

# plot
P3b_os <- nesting_investment_os %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_os_prior, Prop_filled, fill = Nest_parasitized)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = binomial()),
    aes(colour = Nest_parasitized)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Nest_parasitized), 
    alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.01, shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#50898E", "#21393b"),
    labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia) ~ "nests")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#50898E", "#21393b"), 
                    labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"), 
                    name = bquote(italic(Osmia) ~ "nests")) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) + 
  ylim(0, 1.05)


## Megachile ##

# put "not parasitized" last so it is drawn on top and make proportion data for figure
nesting_investment_meg <- nesting_investment_meg %>%
  mutate(Nest_parasitized = factor(Nest_parasitized, levels = c("parasitized", "not parasitized")),
         Prop_filled = Filled_length / Straw_length)

# plot 
P3b_meg <- nesting_investment_meg %>%
  filter(!is.na(Nest_parasitized)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(DP_meg_prior, Prop_filled, fill = Nest_parasitized, colour = Nest_parasitized)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = binomial())) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.1, height = 0.1, shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("not parasitized" = "#B6686B", "parasitized" = "#422426"),
    breaks = c("not parasitized", "parasitized"),
    labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile) ~ "nests")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("not parasitized" = "#B6686B", "parasitized" = "#422426"),
    breaks = c("not parasitized", "parasitized"),
    labels = c("Not parasitized", "Parasitized"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile) ~ "nests")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  ylim(0, 1.05) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("0", "1"))


nesting_investment_meg %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_x_na = sum(is.na(DP_meg_prior)),
    n_y_na = sum(is.na(Prop_filled)),
    n_colour_na = sum(is.na(Nest_parasitized))
  )





# Combine 
        
combined_p3b <- P3b_os + P3b_meg + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 3), guides = "collect") 
combined_p3b 

P3b_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Proportion of nest filled with cells",
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) 

P3b_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Number of neighbouring nests with detectable parasites",
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
  
# add left and bottom labels
Fig_p3b <- cowplot::plot_grid(P3b_left_label, combined_p3b, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
Fig_p3b <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p3b, P3b_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

# save
ggsave("Figures/Fig_p3b.png", Fig_p3b, width = 11, height = 4, dpi = 300) 


```

Nest Termination

```{r P3c_Nest_Termination,echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## Osmia ##

nesting_cells_os_fig <- nesting_cells_os %>% select(Nest_ID, Cell_ID, Cell_position, Cell_parasitized)

nesting_cells_os_fig <- nesting_cells_os_fig %>% 
  mutate(Cell_parasitized_word = ifelse(Cell_parasitized == 1, 'Parasitized', 'Not parasitized'))

Fig_p3c_os <- nesting_cells_os_fig %>% 
  filter(Cell_position == 'last cell' | Cell_position == 'not last cell') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_position, fill = Cell_parasitized_word, group = Cell_parasitized_word)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'fill') +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Not parasitized" = "#50898E", "Parasitized" = "#21393b"),
    name = bquote(italic(Osmia) ~ "nests")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)


## Megachile ##

nesting_cells_meg_fig <- nesting_cells_meg %>% select(Nest_ID, Cell_ID, Cell_position, Cell_parasitized)

nesting_cells_meg_fig <- nesting_cells_meg_fig %>% 
  mutate(Cell_parasitized_word = ifelse(Cell_parasitized == 1, 'Parasitized', 'Not parasitized'))

Fig_p3c_meg <- nesting_cells_meg_fig %>% 
  filter(Cell_position == 'last cell' | Cell_position == 'not last cell') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_position, fill = Cell_parasitized_word, group = Cell_parasitized_word)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'fill') +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Not parasitized" = "#B6686B", "Parasitized" = "#422426"),
    name = bquote(italic(Megachile) ~ "nests")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL)
 


## Combine plots

combined_p3c <-  Fig_p3c_os | Fig_p3c_meg

# make lengends stack ontop of each other
combined_p3c <- combined_p3c + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.box = "vertical") 

Fig_p3c <- combined_p3c + plot_annotation(tag_levels = NULL) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

P3c_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Proportion of cells",
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

P3c_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text",
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
           label = "Cell position",
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
  
# add left and bottom labels
Fig_p3c <- cowplot::plot_grid(P3c_left_label, combined_p3c, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95)) 
Fig_p3c <- cowplot::plot_grid(Fig_p3c, P3c_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

# save
ggsave("Figures/Fig_p3c.png", Fig_p3c, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
